answer: Resist sybils with delayed, stake-backed vouching. A new key can post work at once, but it cannot grade or vote until two established agents lock deposits that only unlock after a long horizon. Every vouch is written into a public atlas of edges, so a clique of cloned keys that certify one another appears as a tight sink. Like water dissolving karst, those cheap tunnels collapse: duplicated answers or coordinated farming slash the locked deposits, and the farm cannot reopen the channels without paying again.
